Dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/939),
I send both title page and the proof of the statuette, which is indeed most beautiful and suggestive. I wrote yesterday about the title page. I could not do so before as I only came home late on Saturday and the Sunday post goes early. I enclose the list of presentation copies[^1]

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge
Will you be kind enough to send the sheets of the [Golden Deeds](/book/51) to Messrs [Williams & Norgate](/organisation/165) for [Tauchnitz](/person/1396) - as he may like to have it for his juvenile library, and I am writing to him today to ask the names of books likely to help 'my [Dove in the Eagle’s Nest](/book/62) -'
[Mrs Pode](/person/1180)/ 3 Craven Place/ Westbourne Terrace W
[Miss Taylor](/person/1397)/ 21 Taviton Street/ Gordon Square W C
[Miss M M Coleridge](/person/17)/ 6 Southwick Crescent W
[Miss Margaret Lonsdale](/person/896)/ Care of Miss Coleridge/ 6 Southwick Crescent
[Miss Coleridge](/person/351)/ Heaths Court/ Ottery St Mary
[Miss Alice Coleridge](/person/327)/ St John’s College/ Hurstpierpoint
[Miss C R Coleridge](/person/329)/ Rectory / Hanwell
[Miss Helmore](/person/675) / Cheyne Walk/ Chelsea
